headline: Re-Arch construction is over one month ahead of schedule; district office will be out by July 1st, 2027.
summary: A video timeline showed the Re-Arch construction work. Brick is ordered, and an electrician is due Sept 17th to install the lights and wiring. The district office broke its lease, and the group discussed a move-in target of spring break or end of June.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the Aug 19, 2026 meeting, 8-0.

School District Offices Workgroup Agenda   
Meeting #13 – Wed Sept 16th 2026, Merril Conference Room 8 AM  
 
1. Roll Call  
Members Present: Dan Black, Amity Small, Bob Slater, Jay Parent, Shaun 
Mulholland, Tim Porter, James Danis, and Dave Wholley, Paul Marinace.  Re-
Arch Reps also present. 
 
2. Approval of Minutes of Aug 19, 2026, Meeting  
Motion: Shaun, 2nd: Tim. 8 – 0. 
 
3. Re-Arch Progress & Items to Discuss 
Video timeline of construction shown to the group. They are over one month  
ahead of schedule. Brick has been ordered. Working with masons on 
availability. Preparing for winter conditions. Group also shown the website 
with photos and time lapses. Project updates and schedule listed.  Parking lot 
and lighting discussed. Electrician to arrive Sept 17th to stand up the light 
and wire. Poles are in. Remaining construction will be buttoned up after. 
Discussion of integration with the Town; working groups to ensue.  
 
4. Budget Updates 
District Office has broken its lease and will be officially out by July 1st, 2027 
Target of spring break or end of June for move-in date to new D.O. Soft 
costs discussed. Will come at the end of the project. Traffic study to ensue. 
 
5. Public Comment  
None 
 
8. Adjourn 
8:41 am. Motion by: Bob   2nd: Tim   8 - 0
